We need propose retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to output JSON route with reactions and template IDs. We need to find appropriate templates. Could use known transformations: sulfonamide formation, amide coupling, Doebner modification (forming α,β-unsaturated acid). The target has sulfonamide linking a tolyl sulfonyl to phenyl ring with unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). So retrosynthesis: disconnect amide bond between carbonyl and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). That gives carboxylic acid precursor: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/CO)cc2)cc1? Actually the α,β-unsaturated acid: /C=C/C(=O)N... The forward amide formation: carboxylic acid + aniline -> amide. So retro step 1: break amide to give acid (α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So precursor1: α,β-unsaturated acid: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/CO)cc2)cc1? Wait the acid is the same but with COOH instead of CONH-aniline. The unsaturated acid attached to phenyl sulfonyl. So structure: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/ C(=O)OH)cc2)cc1 . That's the acid.

Second retro step: disconnect the α,β-unsaturated acid formation via Doebner modification: break the double bond and carboxylic acid formed from aldehyde + malonic acid. So precursor: aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring with sulfonyl) and malonic acid. The aldehyde is the phenyl ring with sulfonyl and para-methyl: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(CHO)cc2)cc1 . So we need that aldehyde.

Third retro step: sulfonamide formation: disconnect sulfonamide bond between tolyl amine and sulfonyl chloride. So precursors: tolyl amine (p-toluidine) Cc1ccc(N)cc1 and sulfonyl chloride: ClS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(CHO)cc2 (or the sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl with aldehyde). So final three steps.

We need template IDs. We don't have catalog; we can search. Let's search for amide coupling template.
